template.description: The template, in Markdown; absent when the repository has none.

base.description: For a pull, the branch it is to merge into: the template there.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle.

main.description: The template a repository asks its pulls or issues to be written from, as `knotless pull template` reads it: `.knotless/pull.md` or `.knotless/issue.md`, at a pull's base branch or else the default branch. Opening one whose body has none of the template's sections is refused. No authentication; responses are not personalized.

description: What a repository asks a new pull's or issue's body to follow.
